title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer (Associate / Fresher)
job_description:
We are looking for an Associate Cloud & DevOps Engineer to automate build, test, and release pipelines, maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP, and ensure high availability of containerized services.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
- Containerize microservices using Docker and orchestrate scalable workloads on Kubernetes (EKS/GKE).
- Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
- Administer Linux virtual machines, shell scripting, security configurations, and reverse proxies (Nginx).
- Monitor cluster health, logging, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

Minimum Qualifications:
- B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or Electronics.
- Practical experience with Linux command line, Bash scripting, and Git.
- Foundational knowledge of AWS or GCP cloud computing services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC).
- Demonstrated understanding of Docker container lifecycle and basic Kubernetes concepts.
min_education: B.Tech / B.E. in CS / IT / ECE
